chunks: Muhammad ibn Khālid narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abū Khālid, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever manifests for the people what Allah loves and confronts Allah by [doing] what He dislikes, he will meet Allah while He loathes him.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of showing off piety while doing what God dislikes?
ai.summary: Compiled by Husayn ibn Sa'id al-Ahwazi in *Kitab al-Zuhd*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defines the essence of *riya'* (showing off) as a dissonance between public persona and private reality. It carries the profound implication that such hypocrisy results in divine *maqta'* (loathing), emphasizing that God’s judgment is based on the inner truth of one’s deeds rather than their external appearance.
